review:
Jewelled eggs on five lines, with a 5,000x max win and Wazdan's highest volatility rating: Extreme. Two Cash Out features in the base game give you two routes to bonus prizes on any spin.

Collector symbols and Countdown Boosters build towards Free Spins, where the collected values pay. Chance Level has three settings (x2, x5 and x10 the bet) that make features more likely at a higher cost. 96.12% RTP. Very swingy, so take plenty of demo spins first.
pros: Free demo available on the Wazdan website
cons: Very high volatility – long dry spells are normal
Short-session results can differ widely from the long-term average
